Power-ups are revealed by destroying certain enemies or special bonus capsules, and several are given to the player for free at the start of a level. The weapons can be upgraded by collecting the same power-up several times.

The game features a two-player mode, with two ships moving against the aliens at the same time.

140170.overview: Future Bike Simulator is a futuristic action game set in 1999. The government forbid motorcycles and so the billionaire Finnius M Houlder built a hovercraft replacement. And while he was at it, he also added some guns. So now his goal is to drive and kill people who move slower than him (which is everyone). Killed enemies leave behind money which can be reinvested into vehicle upgrades between levels. A life is lost when the energy bar is completely drained, so it is advised to dodge obstacles and vehicles. Movement is restricted to left and right; the speed can't be regulated.

141095.overview: Eye of the Dragon is a nice little Mahjong game. The game offers a no-frills, no-nonsense Mahjong experience. If you don't know how to play the game, this one isn't for you as it doesn't provide any rules or guidance to introduce you to the game. If you already know how to play, though, the game provides a decent enough challenge for a quick Mahjong fix. If you are a Mahjong fan, there's probably nothing better than being able to quickly jump into a game, during that precious 10-15 minutes coffee break.

141118.overview:
The F1 Tornado flies from the allies aircraft carrier based on the edge of the Gulf battle zone. Your mission is to seek out and destroy all enemy installations, frigates, aircraft, tanks and gun emplacements.
 
As well as oil-cooled machines fire, the F1 Tornado is also well armed with Target Allocating Missiles capable of destroying sea level enemy installations. All weapon systems are controlled via the Head Up Computer Display. Prepare for battle, you have only three chances to complete your mission... Best of luck...

141140.overview:
F1-Racer is a simulation type game which uses 3D polygons to recreate Formula 
One racing on your Amiga.

141182.overview: The objective of the game is to remove the blue creatures from the grid by making them drop to the bottom but make sure that the pink ones remain on the grid. On each level its game over if you lose half of the pink characters.

141262.overview: Fantasy Flyer is 2D side scrolling action game. The player controls a flying, dragon-like creature with big eyes, flaming lizard female and wall crawling gnome. The fly and walk, exploring level, kill strange enemies, looks for special objects (like chariot's parts) to be able to move on, and avoids various traps. The creatures have a limited amount of shots. Game uses big 2D sprites (for 16-bit platform).

141264.overview: You control Freddie as you work your way up and down from one floor to another using only ladders and his own two feet. He needs to capture all of the floating hearts that he can without being tripped up by the Sneakers. Freddie has four levels to ambulate, and lots of Sneakers to hop over, before he's able to take on the biggest Sneaker of all (High-Top). The tenth and last prize awaits Freddie just over the head of High-Top. Once Freddie has that prize, he earns bonus points and gets a new screen to try.

141314.overview:
Fighting Soccer is a coin-op conversion and like its arcade counterpart the action is viewed from above and the screen scrolls to keep the ball central. You have a team of five players of which you control the one nearest to the ball. The idea of the game is to win an Olympic Gold Medal by beating your opponents in a knock-out tournament. You can use all the normal football skills: dribbling, shooting and heading but what makes Fighting Soccer different is that you can also foul your opponents. If you decide that an Olympic medal is worth a bit of foul play then you'd better watch out for the ever vigilant referee.

Because of the difficulty factor many people will give up after a few plays, real soccer fans with lots of perseverance may get some enjoyment from Fighting Soccer but I think that the repetitive nature of the game may even get to them after a while. If Activision hoped to net a winner with Fighting Soccer then this effort is well wide of the posts.

141316.overview:
Communication between two planets has ceased and the Federation suspect alien beings of interrupting contact and discovering a secret research station on the planet Ipsos III. Your mission, as Agent YG30, is to go to Ipsos III and save the relevant data banks that will protect your people from their space enemies. Receive your Final Command and hold the future of the Federation in your hands!

Final Command is a graphic adventure in a science-fiction setting. The player explores the environment in a first-person perspective, collects items and solves puzzles. The controls are completely mouse based: when it meets an interactive item, its form changes. After clicking once, a selection of commands appears which are also chosen with a click. Up to three save games can be saved on the game disk. The story is told in animated sequences.

141317.overview:
Your training was tough. Now is the time for your FINAL MISSION in Labyrinth of terror – the last stage of insanity.

Many before you have tried, all have failed. The last one was found impaled in a pitfall with his 2x10³ caliber game gun between the bones. The Labyrinth want you dead! You must destroy the spirit of the Labyrinth. The red and yellow balls of madness and insanity, touch them and you are closer to freedom. Dangerous mines, traps and energy fields will push you to the limit. Will your “FINAL MISSION” become your final disaster? Was your training in vain?

141321.overview: The basic idea is to guide Cool Coyote on an exploration of the entire level and locate the six parts of the key. Once all eight parts have been collected, then the exit will open, so it’s simply a matter of finding the thing. The key parts can only be found by destroying the local creatures, which is achieved by freezing them with snowballs then bashing into them. Careful though, dally to long and the creatures will defrost. Along the way there’ll be the chance to pick up bonus present, interact with wales and watch the snow falling down. Watch out also for bonus pups to escort to the exit.

141327.overview: Fireblaster is a Galaga style shoot'em up with enemies moving in different patterns on each level. The player can move left and right but also forward or backward. On certain levels the player can pick up an extra ship to get double the fire power.

141336.overview: Firefly is a simple space racing/shoot 'em up game where you have to navigate your spaceship and avoid nasties in the same time. Written by Mark Sheeky in 1993.

141337.overview: It's your first day on space patrol, and you've been given control of the latest "Firestar" space sector patrol craft. Your task is to rid the spaceways of all illegal/dangerous crafts that invade Earth space.

141340.overview:
Fireteam 2200 is a tactical wargame set in the 23rd century. You take the role of the leader of a taskforce (or "Fireteam") tasked with undergoing a series of missions.

As with most war games you get to assemble your crew and select your scenario, while the action itself takes place in a top-down map from which you view your deployed units and issue orders such as movement commands, weapon assignations and, of course, who to fire at. You can build a squadron of up to 16 units starting with a base budget that allows you to choose from 30 different combat units and 25 different weapon types.

Features modem head-to-head multiplayer gameplay for up to two players across platforms (meaning an Amiga player can show a DOS player how it's done).

141341.overview:
Following the break up of the old Superpower blocks at the end of the 20th Century colonial wars ravage the world. Powerful beam weapons and defensive energy shields are developed that give a new lease of life to ground warfare and reinforce the place of the Armoured Fighting Vehicle. The new Grav engine means a tank can skim across the battlefield at the speed of a 1980's helicopter gunship and is worth a battalion of the 20th century equivalent.

Firezone simulates this new style of combat in which battles are fought in minutes not hours. Although several countries and power blocks are contesting what's left of the World the main protagonists feature in the game and are the European League and the Pacific Combine. You can command either side against human or an artificially intelligent computer opponent in three pre-set scenarios or design and save your own using the game generator.

141342.overview: First Person Pinball is a solid but little-known early pinball game from Tynesoft. Although there is only one table, the game's highlight lies in the ability for up to four players to compete for the high score table, good graphics, and reasonable ball mechanics. Overall, a nice little early pinball title that looks great and plays well, although not in the same league as Macadam Bumper in terms of table design: the First Person Pinball table is quite generic. Great for the sake of completing pinball fans' collection, but doesn't really offer a lot of play value compared to other games.

141358.overview: Meet Ted E. Bear, a talking computer friend who introduces young children to the world of geometric shapes. Through Ted's helpful spoken messages and encouraging words, children independently use geometric shapes to build toys. Each child has their own Toy Box where the toy maker decides which toys to save, print or delete. Children can accompany Ted to the Toy Fair where they identify special shapes and send Ted flying! In the Make-A-Match Game children match shapes and toys playing by themselves, with Ted E. Bear, or with a friend. Adult helpers can customize First Shapes for each child including setting spoken reward messages, learning modules and speech controls.

141361.overview:
Football Glory gets a makeover in this recreation of five-a-side football. The basic game engine is much the same, with identical menu systems and similar styling to the team selection (albeit with less players). Gameplay is similar to Sensible Soccer, with loose ball control (although there are 3 options for this), small playing sprites and an emphasis on ground passing, plus a few speech bubble comments when the ball goes dead.

Two distinct sets of 5-a-side rules are featured, English and International, with full explanations of the differences built into the game. There are seven different pitch surfaces, ranging form grass and Astroturf to concrete and plastic, as well as the option of playing without a fence keeping the ball constantly in play. Tournaments and friendlies can be played, using either club or international teams.

141367.overview: You have to move the small space ship through the scenery without touching the walls. Look for a ball and try to fly in short distance to it, then hit space to pick it up. The level ends, if you climb to the top. If your ball is destroyed (but not the ship) enter ESC to get a new ball. Fleuch is based on the Thrust from the C64.

141381.overview: Flight Path 737 is a flight simulator or as the cover says an "advanced pilot trainer". The player is the pilot of a jet airliner and his task is to take of from an airport, climb over the mountains that surrounds it and then land safely on an airfield in the valleys below. The player only gets one chance as there is only enough fuel for one landing. The game is played from a first person perspective and the screen is split into two parts: a landscape view at the top and the instrument panel below. The instrument panel shows all the information that is needed such as altitude, speed and artificial horizon. The game can be played on six different skill levels. Each level adds more complexity to the task.

141382.overview: Flippit is a puzzle game where the player has to swap the colour of squares so the grid being played on matches the grid on the bottom right corner. When the player clicks on a square with the joystick it swaps colour and other squares round it. There are over a 100 levels to complete. Other things the player can see on the screen are how many moves he or she has taken and the timer. There is no time limit, but the faster and the fewer moves the player completes a grid with, the better the high-score.

141383.overview: Flotte is a game where player deploys his ships (of lengths varying from 2 to 5 squares) on a square grid. Then player shoots at the computer controlled player's grid by clicking on a location. The defender responds by "Hit" or "Only Water". You try to deduce where the enemy ships are and sink them. First to do so wins.

141386.overview:
Remember I Play 3D Soccer? Well, in their almost obsessive quest to make the ultimate 3D soccer game, Simulmondo have gone a step further. Now, instead of just viewing the pitch from one angle, you rotate the whole world around your player.

The effect is impressive as vectors and sprites are scaled and stretched to create a convincing pitch environment. Unfortunately, the game is practically unplayable: it's almost impossible to keep track of what's going on and you can't instantly swap control from one player to another. This leads to an overwhelming feeling of disorientation. There's a comprehensive tactical and team management aspect to the game, but when it plays as badly as this, who cares?

141389.overview: Football Masters is a football management simulation from ESP Software. The game allows the player to control a team from the four English divisions. Very easy to pick up and play with no fancy graphics, just a simple clock counting up and goal, cards and injuries highlighted. There were two versions of this game, one supporting 512K systems and one supporting 1MB Systems.

141391.overview:
What you get from TopDown is a hog standard Pacman clone with very few frills. You use joystick or cursor keys and troll off round a whole bunch of mazes - you get 50 on the disc - while being pursued by some arthritic ghosties. Yup, there are dots, power pills which give you the ability to put the ghosties out of their misery, and wraparound corridors that'll take you from one end of the screen to the other.

Gameplay, when you get down to it, is not particularly fast or startlingly responsive. So far, so standard, but the redeeming feature of Footman is the comprehensive Maze Editor. This lets you design your own mazes in which to weeble, providing all sorts of opportunities to shock maiden aunts and generally be terribly rude.

141408.overview: A simple arcade game, where you have to test your skills with F1 cars. The sound effect consist of the now standard engine drone and the 'kaboom' as two cars collide and, on the whole, they are sufficient. Some of the graphics are well presented, the scrolling background is used well and changes with every track. The track itself, however, is patterned with dark and light shades of gray and can be very off-putting. Overall, Formula 1 Grand Prix is something and nothing. It is by no means an outstanding game but it may be worth a viewing.

141411.overview: Forest Dumb is a side-scrolling platform game. The aim for the player is to reach the designated number of coins and the exit gate before the time runs out. All the levels are quite extensive, full of hostile animals, deadly spikes or vanishing stone platforms. Besides the coins the player can collect numerous fruits (points) scattered around the board or use trampoline mushrooms to perform high jumps. The hostile creatures can be killed by a jump on their head. The player can use the quick run which increases the height of the jump. After each level a stage code is provided.

141422.overview: Formula One Challenge falls, sadly, with a disappointing splat into the boring category. There is nothing actually wrong with it, as such, but it just doesn't have any pizzazz, any zing in it. You are, in a very virtual sense, the manager of a Formula One racing team. Armed with only a few hundred thousand quid, you must buy some engines, hire some drivers and equip your team to take on the might of McLaren, Williams, Benetton and all the rest. There's a moderately neat graphic interface where you make your managerial choices (tires and stuff) and then the race storms off. You watch a leaderboard with occasional comments as to what's going on. On the face of it, it's a corking idea. Formula One Challenge just doesn't have whatever it is that makes these things fab. Errors and sloppiness aside, it does have a certain charm. There's plenty of detail in there for F1 enthusiasts, but precious little to enthrall them for long. Sorry.

141951.overview: Fast Eddie's Pool and Billiards is an Amiga snooker/pool sports game released in 1991 by Aegis.

142279.overview:
The sequel to F-19 Stealth Fighter - take America's premiere stealth fighter out for a spin in several battle areas, including the Persian Gulf, Cuba, and even Vietnam. There are various scenarios for each, with air-to-air or ground missions, in "cold war" and full-scale war situations. Players can build up their pilot ranks through completed missions and medals.

The game actually has two flight modes. In the "authentic" mode, you have only 2 weapon bays, but you have higher stealth rating. In the "theoretical" mode, you have 4 weapon bays like F-19 Stealth Fighter, but your plane is easier to detect due to a lower stealth rating.

142303.overview:
The Final Battle is the successor to Legend of the Sword. In the last game, five heroes managed to foil the plans of the evil wizard Suzar. Now he has returned, captured the party and threw them in his dungeon. The player takes the role of one of the group, with the goal to free his comrades, explore the island and stop the threat once and for all.

The main difference to the predecessor is the isometric perspective and a completely icon-driven interface. To interact with the environment, first a click on the ícon and then on the item or person in the playfield is necessary. The puzzles are inventory-based, but the environment plays a big role in the problems and their solutions: the game features a day/night-cycle and a weather system. The people to be freed have different abilities which need to be used for puzzle solving. Despite the perspective, the current group leader is not on screen and the player is meant to see through his/her eyes.

143426.overview: You fly combat air patrols (CAP) in WW2 aircraft armed with guns only, in three separate areas located around your carrier base, against 1-2 computer opponents, or against a single human opponent. An analog rudder control has been added (you can still use the mouse), and also an optional rear view, using a second Amiga and monitor connected with a special parallel cable.

143432.overview:
Fighter Duel: Corsair vs. Zero is a combat flight simulation game for 1-2 players. In single player combat, the player starts on the deck of one carrier, and does the 1 vs 1 combat in three areas located in the sea 12nm from the carrier, each area centered around a geographical feature, either two towers, a tall arch, or two islands. The friend/foe aircraft can be one of the two title models, Chance-Vought F4-U-1D "Corsair" or Mitsubishi A6M5a "Zero".

In two player mode, the players start in the air in one of the three areas of Tower, Arch or Islands. Both players have to select the same area and also opposite starting headings (North/South) or the session fails to launch. Also the opposing aircraft must be different, you cannot duel against the same aircraft. The carriers modeled are U.S.S. Bunker Hill (CV-17) and Imperial Japanese Navy carrier Shokaku. Environment colours can be changed in setup, if the default setting is not suitable.

143435.overview: You take control of BlubberLip. A brave warrior king who's divine quest is to seek out and destroy enemies. The enemies had first consisted of anyone and anything that moved. This proved counter productive after a while, mainly because the troops were attacking not only peasants and live-stock, but each other. Lately, new enemies started to take land that belonged to the others. The details were not important, they were creatures of violence. As such, the urge to fight summoned a war king to the throne. The time of cow herding was over. The time of war had arrived! At last! Take thy role and be victorious.

143436.overview:
From the people who brought you that excellent version of Donkey Kong a couple of months back comes Frantic Freddie, yet another platform game. If anything (and some may find this hard to believe) it's even simpler than Kong. Hero Freddie has to be maneuvered around the network of platforms and ladders whilst picking up the goodies and avoiding the roving nasties. Not so bad, eh? Ah, but the twist here is that Freddie can't walk through the ladders, so if he's not careful it's very easy for him to get trapped in a dead-end. However, that aside, that's pretty much all there is to say.

It's simple, enjoyable and very fast paced. However, it can get a bit frustrating simply due to the ease with which you can get caught by the ghoulies. (Ahem!) All-in-all, Frantic Freddie's unlikely to keep you glued to your monitor all night long, but it's the sort of game you're likely to load up from time to time just for a quick go.

143437.overview:
Freak Out is a fast-paced strategy game where each level takes the player to a different location, to contain the attack of the fuzzy intruders. The playing field consists of interconnected cells, arranged in concentric squares. The Freaks (which come in four different colors) pop out of a hatch at the center, and can be moved about by rotating and smacking them, which sends them jumping to the next cell (if it isn't occupied). To score points and eliminate Freaks, three of the same color must be placed in adjacent cells, making them vanish in a puff of smoke.

Speed is essential, since the quickly-reproducing aliens line up behind the hatch: if you let the queue get too long, it's game over. Random items and obstacles pop up occasionally, like bonus gems, freezing ice, stone walls, or colored circles (which can only be occupied by a Freak of the same hue). As the game advances, new challenges and mini-puzzles appear, which force the player to respond before more Freaks can be eliminated. A password records the player's progress after every level.

143438.overview:
Frontline is a squad-level tactical strategy game set in many fronts of the World War 2. The included scenarios are Monte Cassino 1944, Guadalcanal 1942, Stalingrad 1943, Pegasus Bridge 1944 and two tutorial missions.

The player commands 10-man infantry squads, to which assigns leaders (their leadership skill having a direct influence on squad's morale) and support weapons (like heavy machine guns – affecting not only firepower, but also movement rate), artillery pieces with crews are also available. Walls and shell holes may provide cover on the varied battlefields. The game features an icon-driven menu-based interface.

143444.overview: Fruit Machine is as can be expected a simulation of slot machine. The game is for one player who controls the machine with the keyboard. There are four reels and the player has to get three of four fruits in a row to win. After a win it's possible to gamble the earnings by choosing if a number is higher or lower than the that is about to appear. The fruits on the reels have number on them and if their sum is ten or greater the player reaches Club Casino. This give access to features and the higher the numbers the better feature is available. To get a better feature it's possible to gamble. If the player gets a question mark he is given a bonus chance which can be additional Club Casino numbers, a free respin or a skill chance.

143445.overview: Welcome to the world of Fruit Salad, a platform game from Grand Master Design. The idea of the game is to collect all of the gems from each level and get to the exit but since evil Triax has turn all of your friends into mutant fruit and vegetables, try to avoid them or die in the process by touching them. The game has 20 levels and the enhanced version has over 60. Every five levels you will be given a level code, you can use these as the main menu screen, and this will start you at the last level code received. If you collect the letters "GAME UP", then you will be able to play the Surf Game! This will enable you to collect extra lives. You can also collect bonuses on screen. They are "F"reeze, "B"onus, "T"urbo and "S"hield.

143446.overview:
Fruitmania is a slot machine simulator for one person. Guus Hildesheim, who also did the graphics for this game, was sysop of the 'BBS de Saen', a Dutch modem-based bulletin board system (BBS).

This game is based on a real fruitmachine. It uses the same bars and the same points. It doesn't check whether or not you are winning and it doesn't cheat.

143451.overview:
The Master of Darkness has taken the possession of the Diamond Goodness splitting it into a thousand pieces and hiding them in his underground caves. Fear and terror are spreading since Diamond of Goodness doesn’t emit it’s positive energy anymore. As the best commander of the Federation, you are charged with the task of collecting the pieces of the diamond.

“Future Shock” is composed of three different levels which have to be flown through. Each level consist of several screens (horizontal and vertical). Collect in each setting up to nine diamonds eliminating as many adversaries as possible. As soon as you get all the diamonds, you automatically move onto the next level.

143452.overview: Future Sport is certainly a copy of the film, The Running Man, but in own way is it similar to the game of the same name by Grand Slam. Although the game is not bad and has a few addictive qualities, it lacks much variety and becomes repetitive very quickly. I must say that Future Sport is not one of Actual Screenshots' better products.

144090.overview:
In this game the player manages a Formula 1 team, starting with a certain budget of around $6,000,000. The gameplay includes the economical and technical management and driving simulation on the famous 16 circuits.

In management phase you should select a racer from around the world to enlist, one of 10 or custom cars to buy, enlist supporting team of engineers and mechanics, modify the car for money, examine the next circuit, and adjust the car's parts.

In simulation phase you should accelerate/decelerate the car, shift the gears, correctly go into bends, and finish the laps as fast as possible to get a better position at the finish.

'Single track' and 'Championship' modes are allowed as well as gameplay for 1-2 players. In 2 players mode each player takes part in the game sequentially.

144103.overview:
Objective: Total defeat of the enemy forces by destroying all the enemy industrial and ground assets.

First came the original FALCON F-16 Fighter Simulation, with all its superb flight characteristics, full weapons complement, and impressive 3-D graphics displays. With the new mission disk, expand your FALCON world into a full campaign with all the extras.

Your "ace" pilot skills are about to be put to the ultimate test. Today's target is the enemy power station, vital to their offensive. Naturally the location is deep in enemy territory and to fly there avoiding all the SAM sites, MiGs and hostile tanks will require all your resourcefulness. So far your successes have been mounting. The last of the T-80 tanks was dangerously close to your airbase before your last Mk84 bomb dropped dead on target. Then there was the attack on the seemingly indestructible bridge which is the main route for enemy supply trains. With your heavy bomb load you were a real "sitting duck" for those feisty MiG-29's, but thanks to some superb maneuvering and steady nerves, you received yet another ribbon for a job well done. But no time to reflect, here they come again..."Bogey at 6 o'clock - closing fast!"

144106.overview:
Falcon Operation: Firefight (in Europe released as Falcon Mission Disk Volume 2) allows the pilot to fly the updated Falcon F-16C in 12 new missions with a focus on air-to-ground operations to support allied ground forces in a war zone with a major escalation developing. Not only ground forces require support, but also the enemy is launching raids on friendly forces. Your support is required in both arenas...

Updated features include the AMRAAM 120A medium range air-to-air missile, the AGM-88A anti radar missile, an improved AIM-9M short range air-to-air missile, and an updated APG-68 radar. Furthermore extra enemy aircraft have been included: Mi-24 "Hind" helo and the MiG-27 "Flogger D". Another change is the option to allow multiple enemy aircraft to join the battle scene.

The 12 missions are: - Heavy Metal: Knock out two enemy tanks - Five Carder: Destroy four pontoon bridges - Hind Hit: intercept two Mi-24 Hinds - Lone Ranger: Destroy one MiG - Truck Interdict: Destroy three trucks - Ace High: intercept and destroy one MiG - Tank Park: Hit five tanks - Triple Trouble: Destroy two MiGs - Dragon's Head: Damage the enemy supply line - Interceptor: Kill one MiG-27 and protect the Arsenal - Dragon's Tail: Damage the bridge - Home Base: Destroy one MiG-27

144193.overview:
Fatal Heritage lives up to it's name: the protagonist of the game inherits a farm including a big treasure. Unfortunately said farm is far away and the local crime syndicate has an interest in the treasure, too. The game takes place in various locations all over the world.

The game is played in first-person with static screens which want to be explored with the mouse cursor. The interaction with the game world uses a traditional graphic adventure approach: first the action is chosen on the icon bar and then the player clicks on an object in the game world. This way the player solves the mostly inventory based puzzles, e.g. finding the misplaced will. There are also some multiple-choice conversations and friends which may accompany the player for a limited time. Those have special abilities, insights and objects which are important to solve some puzzles. The inventory is limited to 15 objects and when the player wants to take an additional one, an old has to be permanently destroyed which opens up the way for dead ends.

There is a constant time limit: a bar at the top of the screen shows how near the syndicate killer are. If the time is up, the player needs to finish the current location or the killers will end the game violently. To earn money, there are a few cards and dice mini games to participate in.

144194.overview: Familien Duell is based on the German TV game show of the same name. The game can be played by up to ten players

144233.overview:
Fighter Command is a sophisticated simulation of air combat. Complete whit
 this game is the first Combat Module- consisting of over twenty scenarios
 set in the Middle East in the modern day.

 The objective of the game is to defeat your opponent- to do which you will
 need to first secure you own defences, and then launch attacks against enemy
 targets. Once you have wiped out the enemy's offensive capability, or done
 so much damage that they surrender, you have won.

144235.overview: The President of the United States has put you in charge of stopping the trafficking of drugs into the United States. To accomplish this, you pilot a Firehawk helicopter gunship through seven missions that involve rescuing agents and destroying drug producing facilities. When flying you survey the whole landscape from a top down view. However, this view changes to a 3rd person perspective when you are extracting an agent with your helicopter winch.

144236.overview:
The Fire Brigade was the 48th Panzer Korps, which was heavily involved in the battle this wargame recreates - Operation Barbarossa, Germany's attempted offensive in Russia during World War 2. The game recreates the situations at 3 dates in the attack, and you can play any of those from either side.

You have a range of units under your command, as although the battle was largely tank-based there were also infantry and air units involved. Units can be told which positions to take up, and whether to defend a spot or consciously aim to attack it. The game's AI incorporates the significance of bridges, rivers and forests as strategic points, and your units can be subject to fatigue.

144237.overview:
In First Contact, a communication space station is overrun by aliens. The player takes control over the maintenance droid with the goal to keep the station running as long as possible. The aliens will destroy vital part of the station and the droids need to repair them. There are also other important tasks like getting repairing equipment out of lockers or refueling.

The player does not control the droid directly, but programs a script which is then performed independently. If the droid is interrupted, they stop the program and don't fight back. It has to be manually restarted by the player. To be more effective, the droid can be split into three droids with different abilities which have to be programmed individually. The game ends when all droids are disabled by the aliens, but if only one or two are down they can be repaired. There are four decks which can be reached through teleports.

144239.overview:
First Class with the Shoe People is an educational game based on the TV cartoon The Shoe People. It consists of a basic drawing program and five mini games. Those either have a difficulty selection or become harder over time.

- Trampy Visits His Friends: Trampy stumbles on various objects and the player has to type in their names.
- Sgt. Major Sorts It Out: The major dropped the contents of a few shelves on the floor and the player has to sort them back in. Each shelve represents a certain shape, e.g. round.
- The Great Alphabet Robbery: The player has to help the policemen to catch Sneaker who stole the alphabet's letters. This is accomplished by solving word puzzles.
- Wellington Goes to the Park: The player has to balance out a seesaw by adding the correct amount of certain shapes. Focuses on teaching recognizing numbers and simple summation.
- Charlie's Big Day: The clown performs a number of tricks and the player has to remember them in the correct order.

144240.overview:
Five fighters have come together to fight in three different locations, Egypt, Japan and America. Only one can be Fist Fighter champion.

Fist Fighter is a one to two-player fighting game on a single screen which does scroll left and right a short distance. Various options are available like location of fight, difficulty and number of players. You also have the choice of five fighters. The joystick is used to deploy various moves to hurt your opponent and two bars are seen at the top of the screen, which gets smaller when you or your opponent are hit. There is also a timer which counts down from 99 seconds.

144241.overview: In Flamingo Tours you are the manager of a travel agency. With your starting money you have to reserve hotel rooms, buy buses, charter planes or hire some cruising ships. If you are successful over time, you can open more bureaus all over Germany. If you don’t have enough money you can go to the local bank for some credits. The game has 3 difficulty levels, and 4 players can play hot-seat together.

144242.overview: Flip Flop is an Amiga miscellaneous board game released in 1987 by Kingsoft.

144243.overview:
Without any substantial background story or colourful characters to back it up, Flyin' High is all about racing.

One of the few fully 3D racing games on the Amiga, you must race your car on 20 tracks divided into four worlds; city, forest, jungle and arctic. Spread out on the tracks are not only obstacles, but also money which must be picked up so that you may mend or upgrade your car between the races. If the computer drivers are not interesting enough for you, you and three of your friends may race simultaneously in split-screen mode. Apart from tyre and engine upgrades, you also have a limited weapons arsenal to slow down the competition.

144247.overview: Football Manager: World Cup Edition 1990 is the third game in the popular Football Manager series. This time your mission is not to coach an club team, but one of the national teams that started in the real World Cup 1990 qualifications. Master the qualification games to reach the final tournament and try to get the World Cup. You can fill up your team with 22 players, and can give each of them individual tactical game instructions. Before each game you give an interview that has influence of the morals of your players. In every half-time you can give new instructions to your team and make tactical corrections.

144248.overview:
You can try your hand at managing a Formula 1 team of your choice in this simulation. First of all you must choose your team and sign deals with drivers and engine and tyre suppliers, all from within your budget – pit crews must be hired and engine performance maximised within the remaining budget.

Between races you must select tyre compounds and wing settings for the circuit, and can peruse championship standings and records. The races are depicted form a side-view of the cars completing the laps, with any position changes, retirements or changes in track conditions reported. You can call your drivers in for new tyres, although refuelling isn’t a feature.

144249.overview:
Baron Frankenstein has instructed his hunchback servant Egor to collect tools and bodies for him to use in his quest to create artificial life. As Egor, the player must search through Frankenstein's castle, the dungeons, the surrounding forest, the local village and other areas in this side-scrolling platformer. Despite the grim themes, the game is a humorous cartoonish one.

Each task begins in Frankenstein's lab with the Baron telling Egor what item he requires. Egor must find it, put it in his sack and return to the lab to receive the next task. Along the way there are enemies such as ghosts, skeletons, rats, bats, animated body parts, local townsfolk and others. Instead of a health bar, Egor has a Frightometer with a range from calm to panic. Touching enemies moves it ever more towards the maximum. Once that is reached, Egor will drop what he is carrying, flee to the lab and in so doing lose a life. There is a way of reducing the meter, though: meeting up with the local serving wench will calm Egor's nerves and return it to zero. It is also reset when an item has been delivered.

Once Egor has found and returned the weather chart requested by Frankenstein, the game introduces a time limit. The timer starts at around 74 minutes and counts down to the electrical storm that will bring the monster to life. Failing to collect all required items within the limit means the end of the game.

144250.overview: Fright Night is based on the 1985 Columbia Pictures movie of the same name. You play vampire Jerry Dandridge in this arcade-style action game. You prowl the rooms of the mansion searching for victims. You have to dodge the Crucifixes thrown at you and sink your teeth into anything that looks tasty. Once you've drained the blood of all your victims, you can proceed to the next level. Keep an eye out for the unhealthy as they will drain your lifeforce; too much bad blood and you're a dead vampire. You can run back to your coffin if you're low on health to regenerate, as well, you must be back in your coffin before the sun comes up, or you're a toasty vampire.

144251.overview:
Die Fugger is an economy simulation combining elements of games like Kaiser and Hanse. Up to six players can compete on one machine.

You're an impoverished nobody in Germany in the year 1500. However, the death of an uncle leads you to inherit 20 barrels of beer and 500 Talers of money. Start your career heading forwards to getting an renowned and rich member of the society. There are six goods to trade, across 11 different cities. But there's a lot more to do then only trading with goods: attack your opponents or bribe them or build alliances with other players.

144290.overview:
In the future NYC has become inhospitable and depraved, with thugs lining every street waiting to pounce on ordinary civilians. Thankfully Freddy Hardest is on hand to face up to the baseball bats and knives, in a side-scrolling beat 'em up game.

As with any Dinamic title, the difficulty level is set high. A few kicks and punches are available to you, and you have one life with energy which depletes as you get hit, but can be recharged by finding a safe space to stand still.

151280.overview:
Foundations Waste is a vertically scrolling shoot-'em-up, in which you have to collect extra weapons, like a side shot, shields, a drone which can be controlled by the inverse control of the player ship and some kind of seeking missiles. Sometimes the power ups are fakes, inverting your control or slowing your ship down. You lose all extra weapons either on dying or on entering a new level.

The enemy forces are tanks, ships, flying vessels and later even space ships. Each level is featuring an end-of-level guard, which can be destroyed for extra points, but can even passed if your fire-power is too low at that moment.

151366.overview: XR-35 Fighter Mission is a horizontally scrolling shooter, developed and published by Anco Software, which was released in Europe in 1988.

178131.overview: In Fantasy Manager you create your own football team either alone or with up to 15 other human players. The game is based on a British TV show that was broadcast at the time of its release. You start the game £25 millions on the bank, but you have no players in your squad so you must buy these. They are all real Premier League players that cost between less than a million up to 5 millions. When you have a complete team you just play match after match and you can earn more money that can be used to buy new players. The matches show highlight sequences where you get to know what happened, e.g. goal, corner or foul.

181215.overview: In this game you must discover the "intruder" object from four pictures

181250.overview:
The Computerized Coloring Books is a collection of three games developed by Capstone Software and published by its parent company IntraCorp for both the DOS and Amiga systems. A port for the Windows 3.1 operating system was planned but never took place. The games are based on Bill Kroyer's film FernGully: The Last Rainforest, Don Bluth's film Rock-a-Doodle, and John Hughes's film Home Alone. The Rock-a-Doodle game was as released with Trolls and An American Tail: The Computer Adventures of Fievel and His Friends on the Capstone CD Game Kids Collection.

The FernGully product was designed to follow an environmental-friendly policy, including the use of recycled paper. After the release of the games, Capstone sent entry forms with the boxed products for a coloring contest. The prize for the best pictures were $100 each.

181252.overview: The Final Trip is a two dimensional vertically scrolling shooter set in space. The player controls a space ship called the Eagle P5 and has to destroy various kinds of enemies. The works similarly to other scrolling shoot 'em ups, such as Vader, but the player here can move up and down and not just left and right. The player has only one life and the game ends upon the destruction of the ship although it can take some hits before that happen. The game is for one or two players and can be controlled with either joystick or mouse.

181253.overview: Football Boss is a sports and sports management game, developed and published by Cult, which was released in Europe in 1989.

181254.overview: The plot of Future Space can be summed up easily: Evil aliens attack Earth and the player, in the role of an experienced fighter, has to kill them. Unfortunately his space ship crash landed and his whole crew died - now the mission has to be concluded on foot. The game features about 30 stages in which the player basically needs to walk from left to right while shooting all opposition with one of the two hand guns - touching the enemies is not advised as it eventually leads to death. However, the exit at the end only opens when all scattered diamonds were collected. To make matters worse, there is also a time limit for each level.

181263.overview:
Hockey Pista simulates the sport of roller hockey. Matches are played on a single screen over a duration set by the player (for single matches). The human player always controls the skater closest to the ball and the goalkeeper at the same time, though the goalkeeper only moves sideways. The game offers single matches against the CPU or in 2-player mode, as well as a championship. The player's team name and colors are customizable.

An updated re-release of the game was sponsored by Italian professional player Franco Girardelli, then in Roller Monza. This version features minor graphical improvements, faster gameplay and a few other tweaks such as splitting matches into halves. The difficulty level is not selectable in this version. It is otherwise the same game as the non-sponsored version.

181593.overview: A horizontal scrolling space shoot 'em up with one long(ish) level. The first Fatal Mission game is not that good technically, it is difficult, you have to be in the right places and you have a limit of two of your bullets on screen at once, so if you are at the left edge firing is much slower and you can't destroy the enemy ships.

181596.overview: This is an add-on for Fighter Bomber, featuring 16 challenging new missions (attack a submarine, protect an airfield etc.), new ground objects/targets and other enhancements. Includes a mission editor.

181621.overview: A footie sports and sports management game by Simon Rush for ESP and created for your amusement in 1991.

181635.overview: Forgotten Mine is an improved Boulderdash clone, equipped with new gadgets, switches, rock or critter generators, remote-controlled balloons, stretchy walls, push trap on enemies, special land that only monsters can dig.

181636.overview: Funturatum is a turn based managerial game played on the planet Whorn. The main goal is to acquire four pieces of a magical object called Funtolmin and combine them with the fifth part being in the hands of the Funturatum mayor, who's willing to sell it for a large amount of gold. The artifact is searched by four rival families, each possessing one element. The game takes place on the 174x174 grid randomly generated map. Each player has a ship with a crew. The turn is restricted to twenty moves, but it may be extended up to thirty one by the purchase of a better ship. The player may move across the sea and send an expedition to the mainland. Finding the plantation allows the production of twelve types of crops, building agricultural facilities, granary, setting military defense and trade with the merchant. All goods may be sold in the cities, where the player may also recruit the crew members, buy one of four types of ships (different capacity of soldiers, goods and range of motion), gamble in the tavern or find a passenger needing transport to a designated location. The land expedition may result in finding chests full of treasure or encountering enemy estates, which may be taken over by force. The enemy may be weakened by hiring a specialist of black work (like sabotage of plantation). In addition various random events can appear during the game.

184790.overview:
This compilation contains the original Falcon game and both released add-ons:

Falcon main game
Falcon Operation: Counterstrike (Mission Disk 1) add-on
Falcon Operation: Firefight (Mission Disk 2) add-on

200877.overview: The game's plot takes place before the original Solomon's Key, and is framed as a story being told by an elderly woman to her grandchildren. The story takes place on Coolmint Island, an island made of ice and home to the winter fairies. When the evil wizard Druidle begins sending flame monsters to attack and melt the island, the queen of the fairies summons the apprentice wizard Dana to defend them, granting him the use of ice magic to help extinguish the flame monsters.

201014.overview:
Following success with the mail-order Football Tactician series, Talking Birds entered the mainstream with this retitled version. It's a football management game, setting you in charge of one of the teams in the top 2 English divisions of the time and giving you control over transfers, tactics and training regimes as you aim to guide your team to success. Initially you can only manage the lower teams, but if you succeed over a few seasons you will become respected enough to have a chance to get the top roles.

The focus is on ultra-realism, which makes it very hard to quickly transform a club's fortunes, as there is a lack of money at many of the smaller teams and attracting players is harder than in the Premier Manager series and similar. Matches are viewed from top-down highlights, with 3 levels of detail (goals-only, highlights and kick-by-kick) offered.

201417.overview:
You experience investing in widely varying securities reacting to periods of peace, tension, war, depression, inflation, recession and recovery!

This is an authentic simulation (in game form) of the real investment world from 1930 through 1984. Four separate portfolios let you compare the performance of four completely different investment strategies over the same time frame!

201420.overview:
The action takes place in the basement of the Mad Professor's Mansion, where his motley crew is holding you captive. These creatures hold the keys to the electrified gates blocking your way to freedom.

Only after answering Fraction problems correctly will the gatekeepers unlock the gates and permit you to pass. But you'd better move fast!!
Incorrect answers are given full screen explanations and an occasional drop down the basement's chutes by the mansion's ghastly ghost.

For one or two players, multi-screen arcade action --- ADDITION, SUBTRACTION, MULTIPLICATION, DIVISION or a VARIETY of problems on three difficulty levels.
Never before have Fractions been so fun.

211084.overview: Parallax sample game for Scorpion Engine. Simple clone of Flappy Bird. Amiga A500 and up.

211087.overview: A short and rare Dizzy style platformer created with REALITY - The Ultimate Software Construction Kit. Music draws heavily from Chris Hülsbeck's Turrican soundtrack. Help Father Tuck find his lost Bible.

211088.overview:
The most horrible thing has happened! Don Jockface, a black bubblegum stole FaYoh's gum-machine. FaYoh, a green gum, used it as storage for his stars. No one actually knows what stars are good for, but gums sure enjoy collecting them. Don Jockface had no interest in the starts though. He just wanted to search for lost coins in the machine. So the black gum carried the machine to the top of his tower, where he thought he could work undisturbed.  

FaYoh must, of course, get his bubblegum-machine back. But that's not all! Don Jockface carried the machine carelessly and dropped stars everywhere in the big tower. Before gum-fighting with Don, FaYoh must find the lost stars!

211089.overview: The Super Mario Bros/Giana Sisters colorful clone from NC.Gamez. "FaYoh" is a bit of an odd title. Here's the backstory: "Scooter" is a popular German eurodance band. "Fire" is one of their biggest hits. Due to the singer's heavy accent, he seems to be constantly yelling "FaYoh" during the song. NC. Gamez thought that was funny and decided to pay homage to it.

211525.overview:
Help Flappy flap his way across the screen.  Along the way there'll be platforms to land on, balls of flame to dodge, and Spikes that you should absolutely dislike.

Written for the Amiga, armed only with a stock A600 (with a 1Mb expansion!) and a copy of BlitzBasic.  (Source included, but messy!)

211627.overview: So amazed were mission command to hear of your surviving the original Fatal Mission, that they decided you were just the man to send to sector ZZZZZeddityzedzedzed. Of course, normal people hide under their beds when they hear such things, but you just turned up your headphones, pumped up the volume and hit the thrusters. So brave, so daring, so very stupid. You blast into space to face the robot hordes.

211709.overview:
The game stars Fred, a legendary C64 persona. Fondly remembers his past journeys. Deciding to relive his adventures he heads out again! You can buy this game with some goodies on APC & TCP. Includes 20 levels from Fred's Back 1 & 2 in Amiga style and 7 chiptunes, high scores and a hidden trainer!

This is essentially a clone/update of the 1993 C64 game, Fred's Back.

211766.overview:
A top down racer.

You can play the game in two modes, "arcade" and "strategy" mode. I played through both modes to check the differences. In arcade mode there is no shop between levels and you must qualify by don't get last in a lap. In this longplay I play the game in strategy mode just to show the shop. The ending is the same in both modes. Just a game over screen.

211778.overview: An entertaining little game. The Aim is to find the flag with limited moves created by Bryan Turnock of BSY. The soundtrack used in the game is "Turn It Into Love" by Stock Aitken Waterman (c) All Boys Music, adapted by BSY. Flag Catcher was written in six hours on May 6th 1992 using AMOS, Deluxe Paint III and Protracker V1.1, and was compiled using the AMOS compiler.

211822.overview: A semi overhead view perspective,  space fantasy arcade adventure. You are a Space Mercenary available for hire.  The main employees are political organizations, but you have worked for paramilitary on past missions. The aim of the game is to assassinate the leader of a rebel faction on an alien planet and solve the puzzles you find.

211844.overview:
FARMIGA: 

 - potatoes can be planted

 - improved graphics smoothness

 - underlined house graphics and added toilet

 - after opening the toilet, we will find a moonshine distillery

 - in the current version, we can produce one bottle of moonshine so far (you cannot get all the products needed for distillation yet)

 - to produce moonshine, you have to click the distillery several times and wait, because each time a different product for distillation leaves off (sugar, potatoes, wheat, yeast and a bottle)

211882.overview: Sequel to Fatal Mission 2.  Space shootemup, player flies 'into' the screen, if you have played Tempest or Gyruss you'll know what it's about. Fly through the space gates. If  you miss them you lose a shield. Shoot things!Don't get by things or things fired by things. Lose all your shields and your next mistake will be your last.

211939.overview: A clone of Rock 'n Roll that was released on the Amigo. It was also on several classic compilations.

211940.overview: Not just a pool game, but for just a few quid you can turn on the strip pool version.

212004.overview: Floaty can jump and fly around, picking up the goodies on the level while avoiding the flying things. Whenever you launch you break the platforms beneath you so you not only have the timer counting down but you have very limited real estate from which to begin your travels. You must leave yourself a place to land at the end to make it to the next level. Good luck Floaty!

212070.overview: Another great party game from Czech provenience. Huge dogfight fun for four. A game based on The Dogfight Simulator game. It was created by Michal Franc, the graphics were provided by Michal Vrzáček and Jan Šulček. There is a humorous but short intro to the game. Up to four players can play. You can also use three different scenes, such as day, night and aurora borealis.

212071.overview: A remake of Artillery Duel. Hall of light calls it a 2D Artillery Puzzler, the puzzle is how much power and what angle to shoot your weapon to hit the other players\artillery guns on the screen. And up to 7 can play!

212134.overview: A self published frisbee game from Gianluca Troiano aka The Fox. FRISBEE FOX was based on Data East's 1994 Neo Geo arcade game WINDJAMMERS.

212285.overview: A homebrew game created by Scot Gordon aka Sabregolly, tthe first release was in 1994 with later revisions coming out until January 15, 2004 for version 2.1.0 but the creator still considered it an alpha release.

212294.overview: Flappy Bird is a straight clone of Flappy Bird for smartphones, itself based on many a one-button game. You let your bird flap its wings by pressing the space key, the mouse button or the joystick button, making sure you stay in the air without colliding with the pipes entering the screen from above and below. One thing this version has over the original is some really great music by Sten Lysholm Larsen.

212297.overview: This is an Amiga interpretation of the phone game - Fappy Birds. It is entirely programmed in Amiblitz 2. How far can you get? On the title screen either click the mouse, press the space bar or joystick/pad fire button. Which ever you click will become your chosen method of control for that game (please note every time you return to the title screen you can choose a different control method). Using your chosen control method, fly the bird above and through the pipes.  Made by Havie Spring for Havsoft in 2014.

212324.overview: The scuttlebutt on Harald Müller is that he would take PD games, tweak them and release them commercially, especially early\promo\pre-release games. I don't know if that is true, but in Falling Down, you need to roll your ball over all the tiles in the level and make them disappear while still making your way to the exit, which is a task that will become increasingly more difficult.

212325.overview:
A strategic/tactical combat game for 2-4 human players created by Kalle Marjola aka Reaper, somehow like Lords of Chaos (or eq.), but has some new features not on other games (of that era) like:

    Event replay
    Map editor
    PBEM-support (play via email, irc dcc or snailmail)
    Multitasking and HD-installable

212326.overview: Fatal Impact is a nice Spanish martial arts, one on one, fighting game. Non-commercial but polished well with music in-game and sounds FX.There are only four fighters although at the moment a second part could be on way with more fighters...

212329.overview: A scrolling vertial shooter created by Ard Joosse (Bitboy), with excellent music by Christian Blaha (The Fox) and additional assistance from Marc van den Ouden. The hostile forces have returned and are trying to take over your planet. They have come in large numbers. The Earth's defense system is overwhelmed, we have plans for a new type of fighter that can stop them, our only hope is if you can somehow get the plans to the factory in time. So you must strap into your shuttle fighter and take them on like it is 1942 in space!

212365.overview: Side-view chopper combat! Fly 7 different attack helicopters with 5 configurable, realistic weapon systems against over 29 enemy and allied units in more than 80 missions. Big explosions and weather effects. All missions and random mission generation included with registration.

212440.overview: A platforming game from Dr. Strange, Rubber Bung and Zzzax of Equinox. Released in 1990, final version released on 08-10-1991.

212448.overview:
Fracas is a Shareware Mech Fighter from Casco/John Smith on the Amiga.  It says in the readme this took 3 years to make.

Basically you have to search down the enemy/ies and destroy them on each generated level.  The game also offers a 2 player mode but suggest you use something to split the screen to stop your opponent cheating.

You do have a selection of different mechs too.  This is a nice game I have only just discovered 28 years later.

212449.overview: A split screen combat and collect the flags game for multi-play combat scenarios on a randomly generated playing field. In this game, which supports up to 6 players, with any number of them as computer controlled, one person only acts as the driver OR the gunner of each tank, not both! The screen is divided into 3 sections, one for each team. Great party game to see who can act as an effective team!

212450.overview: This is actually a remake of a classic MSX game with the same name. It is a nice twist on the Pac-Man formula. Get all the fruit before the ghosts get you and instead of running through a maze, you'll have to reach fruit on different platforms. You reach higher platforms using a springboard (is that an English word?!) and when a ghosts is tailing you, you can kill it with a limited number of bombs.

212489.overview:
Fred the Frog from Robert W. Benjamin requires you to eat insects to enable you to progress through the stages.  The problem is during your journey you have to avoid bees, birds, seagulls, knives, bottles etc as one hit and it's game over and back to the 1st level you go.

The game requires patience as the 1 hit and it's game over is a bit tough.

212490.overview:
Funtris from Xact (as there is another Funtris from Pais Laaksonen is a single player Tetris clone but with extras. The usual Tetris Gameplay is present, But occasionally you get either a Wizard which usually helps out or gives you Bonuses, and an Evil guy popping up during Gameplay whos job is to create big problems for your Game! 
 
The Evil Guy can turn the screen Black and White, Deep Red and even change Key controls, and put large peices in the play area, in order to try and stop you from completing the level

The Wizard pops on, and gives you Bonuses, sometimes removes a line or two from the game, and other effects as well

These additions can help or hinder your Gameplay, which gives the Game a neat touch, and as the Wizard/Evil are completely Random, each Game you play is completely different, Giving the Game quite a decent appeal

While it can make the Game impossible or easy to complete, The Wizard and Evil Guy do add to the Gameplay in terms of variation throughout the Game, making this Game quite unique as far as Tetris Games go

212491.overview: Don't forget to pack your sunscreen for a long day of fishing at the lake, America's favorite pass-time. Fresh water fishing is the best for relaxation and fun. Of course there are also weeds, poison ivy, flies and snakes but FUN right! Well with this game you get all the experience with none of the calamine lotion. So leave your sunscreen at home, but pack your patience and get ready to angle. Choose boat fishing or dock\shore fishing, choose your alter ego, set the type of fish and the goal like Bluegill 11+ would mean you need to catch at least 11 bluegills this session. Remember to get the worms first!

212492.overview: It's returned... The bugs are back! The screws are loose. In this side-angled perspective platformer, created in AMOS by Chris Banks you must fix the bugs and tighten the screws, drop in-capacitators where you must to stun the baddies so you can jump on them and take them out. So grab your wrench and get to work in this sequel to Weird in Edgeways.

212619.overview: A horizontally scrolling space shooter created by Inutilis and released in 2003. Created with AMOS. Source code included.

212701.overview: A poker fruit/slot machine style game created by Saen Software in 1992.

212748.overview: An AMOS Project by A. Campbell aka Black Dragon of Black Dragon Design. This is a full screen, Dungeon Master style RPG with lots of action-packed adventure. Requires an A1200 to function properly. Blood spatter can be toggled off and on prior to gameplay.

212750.overview: Richard "DawnBringer" Fhager has used AMOS to create an addictive puzzle game, a Minesweeper clone, perhaps better called an improvement, called FlagSweeper.  IT was released to PD n November 24, 2003.

212751.overview: Not to be confused with F-15 Strike Eagle from Microprose (which was never released on the Amiga), this flight simulator is by Ultimate Solution and was released for the Amiga in 1991.

212757.overview: A side-view 2D game with a feel very much like Worms. Intended for 2 player or tournament play. You have 100 seconds to pick up any goodies, get the lay of the land and blast your enemy. Unlike Worms the two players do this simultaneously in a world dominated by treacherous waters, boiling lava and potions and goodies that pop up for a few moments and then disappear.

212834.overview: Game created by Richard DawnBringer Fhager is simple yet incredibly playable. You control a single pixel being chased by 25 other pixels. If two or more pixels collide they explode. If any of the enemy pixels get caught in an explosion they also explode. If you hit any enemy or explosions you die! You score n^3 points for the pixels that collide at the SAME time!You also get 1 point/sec for staying alive. The longer a single enemy pixel is alive, the faster it gets. Luckily you get a little bit of a head start. New pixels will respawn after a bit.

213429.overview: Follix is a puzzle game heavily inspired by Atomix, a game from 1990 where the player had to build chemical molecules by connecting correctly the atoms they were made of. Using similar mechanics, in each of its 30 levels, Follix challenges the player to build a piece of a message by sliding in the correct places the tiles that contain the relevant text characters.

213433.overview: Flying Shark Remake is not a completely new game for the Amiga, what we have here is a polished 2022 version of the vertically scrolling shoot'em up, which is based on the original, released in 1988. You fly a biplane and shoot everything out of the sky that turns out to be hostile. And these are super tanks, gun emplacements and other things.

213435.overview:
Only few words for this masterpiece of the games revisited by Axel Software! It was inspired by 'RealPacman' of 'De Videorakkers&Peace', developed during spring/sumer of 2021 and ultimated on 2022. The early PC version was born in 1996, but it never was released; the old 2.0 Amiga version have too many bugs to see the light. Finally we got it, and... ... It Works!
 
As usual eat all the pills and avoid the ghosts. Pick up the bows to get a good or bad gift.

213825.overview: F.C. Manager is a sports football\aoccer management game, developed and published by Impressions (Engergize) Games, which was released in Europe in 1990.

213826.overview: An off-kilter Pong variant created by Michael Hartmann and released as Freeware in 1988.

213829.overview: A logic\thinking game created by Harald Müller (Mueller) and released in 1993. This game was in both the Gamers' Delight and Gamers' Delight 2 game compilations. Jump gems to make them disappear. Try to recreate the pattern shown on the left. It's much trickier than it seems.

213831.overview: 1-4 players jump out of a plane, trying to avoid people and suitcases and stewardesses and wheelchairs etc on the way down, while throwing all of those at the other players, and pulling the parachute at the end for a safe landing. On the options menu, use the F keys and the number keys to change the options.

213834.overview: A single player, strategy game based in a Star Trek-like universe. Control your ship, use your computer to gather information and travel the final frontier. A public domain game created by Doug Stastny and John S. Wells and released in 1994.

213843.overview: This is an arcade game for one player only. It should work on any Amiga with a mouse. You must keep the Fluffles bouncing on the trampoline. If any Fluffle stops bouncing, the game is over. This can be loaded from the Workbench or cli. A high score file is automatically created to keep your high scores on. A fun, VERY addictive game.

213844.overview: For President is a German-language, political strategy game set in the US, developed and published by CompuTec Verlag, which was released in Europe in 1994.

213845.overview: A one to four-player Pac-Man variation. Another stand-out feature is that it runs in high-res (or med-res) 640x256 mode in 16 colours. There are several bonus items, but the ghosts are not nearly as aggressive as in the original.

213846.overview: A Dynablaster\Bomberman clone for up to 3 players created by Allan Jensen and released with known bugs because it was required that you release a game commercially or to PD prior to being part of their developer program.

213847.overview: A mouse based memory\puzzle game by Mark Cameron. Originally released in 1991 and appeared on many public domain game compilations including AMOS PD146 along with Fruit Machine, Norlich Spiele Pack 2 and AMOS Megahits 3. Not an easy game.

213848.overview: A nice, modern 5 reel fruit\slot machine from Steve Potts that will run on even stock Amiga 500's. Has all the extras, nudge, hold and gamble your heart out. Many sites have this title listed as being by Mark Cameron, but it was released as part of a 2 game compilation with Fruit Crush that WAS by Mark Cameron.

213849.overview: Fullspeed is a simple racing game against the time. It takes place on a highway with six lanes which is shown in a top-down perspective. The player can control the speed and needs to dodge slower vehicles by moving left and right. Released in a two-pack along with Microbattle.

213928.overview: Ted E. Bear stars in First Letters and Words as he teaches young children letter and word recognition. With his help children recognize and use both the upper and lower case letters of the alphabet and begin reading whole words. Children accompany Ted through Dinosaur Surprise, a Card Circus and to the Magic Letter Machine. His amazing speech capabilities help them independently solve problems by hearing, seeing, and reading words and simple sentences. Adult helpers customize the learning activities for each child including setting spoken reward messages, learning modules, and speech controls. First Letters and Words gives each child the opportunity to become an independent reader.

214266.overview: Yes indeed welcome to another game from Irongate aka Jojo, a game that doesn't just feature deadly enemies such as zombies, Nazi supermen and other creatures from outer space, but through the two levels of the game, you play as a soldier of the union that has discovered the entrance to an abandoned bunker from World War II; a bunker that was not long ago used as a base of operations experimenting with dangerous alien technology.

214931.overview: You can chose from between two difficulty levels in this Kaboom variant where you need to catch the blood droplets and fish before they get into the shark tank or a feeding frenzy will ensue and you may be on the menu. To complicate things fish and blood fall in slightly different ways and somehow an occasional anvil will drop.

214932.overview: Football Club Manager is a sports and sports management game, developed and published by D & H Games, which was released in Europe in 1992.

214933.overview: An AMOS based shareware release from JP Hamilton of a four-reel video slot machine, released in June of 1994. It features multiple betting lines, nudge, repeat and all the pub-slot features you expect.

214935.overview: A beautiful single player recreation of Frogger for the Amiga platform created with and by Fungus.

215118.overview: King Triton will not let Freddy Fish marry his beautiful daughter Ariel until Freddy can afford the lifestyle a princess like her deserves. So Freddy begins an aquatic adventure to collect gold bars from the bottom of the ocean. You have to carry each bar individually up to the boat on the surface. In each of the sixteen levels, a host of enemies chase you. It is a simple and colorful game with lots of art assets lifted from James Pond. Chris Sorrell even gets a cheeky special thanks in the credits.

215163.overview: A very well done Street Fighter clone for one or two players, with 5 levels of difficulty in the one player game. Fighting Warriors was created by Thomas IP and released to PC in 1992.

215164.overview: Football Simulation is a football\soccer game, developed and published by SPORTsoft, which was released in Europe in 1990.

215317.overview: A public domain crosshairs shooter created by the Venables brothers and released in 1998, in it you are a member of a highly trained SWAT team. It is your job to take out well organized gangs of criminals who have taken hostage, innocent members of the general public for their own evil ends. All attempts at negotiation with the armed gangs have failed. You must dispose of the villains and kill the gang bosses. Only then can you retire and enjoy your pension.

215360.overview:
This was the final version of a real-time strategy game influenced by Command & Conquer and The Settlers. This package features the 40 levels from the Director's Cut edition, and the 40 levels from the Undiscovered Land add-on disk, as well as varied difficulty levels.

The game features 20 different buildings, many of which require resources produced or modified from another building. As well as knights, your population includes Maidens (breeding is covered more realistically than most God-sims, in which the guys seem to reproduce by magic), Wizards (who can use the bodies of the dead to create buildings) and peasants, who can be trained to become guards, who can graduate into being full soldiers. Combat can be initiated by sending soldiers into enemy terrain, and attack methods such as arson can be taught to the peasants. There are 4 distinctly different types of landscape - Summer, Winter, Lava and Gloomy.

215481.overview: Fast Brain is a Tetris variant. The game features three types of gameplay. The first one requires connecting four same types of bricks - diagonally or horizontally.. Second one is much faster, but requires connecting only three bricks. In addiction the player need to arrange displayed from time to time pattern in order to remove already connected bricks. The last one is a mix between first two modes. The size of the wheel is larger than in most of games of this type and requires scrolling the screen.

215486.overview: Flower: For the Love of the World Enchanted Road (also known as FLOWER)  is an unreleased platform game.

215532.overview: Furtum Sacrum is the new videogame from the IronGate team that places us in the late Middle Ages. Specifically, in the Northwest of Spain, where there are a number of pilgrimage routes and roads with a lots of monasteries flourishing everywhere. These monasteries offer services to pilgrims in exchange for alms, they also have their own sources of funding, their crops and local products.

215533.overview: DARK TIMEThe Count has commissioned the Knight Esquio to clean a section of the Camino de Santiago from all kinds of creatures, witches, dogs, even the Holy Company... Don't forget to save the pilgrims you meet along the way. This seems to be the end of magic times. The Count has the Caballero Esquio clean a stretch of the Camino de Santiago of all kinds of creatures, witches, dogs, even the Holy Company. Do not forget to save the pilgrims you find on the road. This seems to be the end of magic times.

217538.overview: FunTris is a multiplayer-tetris. 2-4 players can play at the same time.

218700.overview: A homebrew release created with the Amiga version of the Boulderdash Construction Kit and released in Legends Production Pack Volume 1 and in the French Boulderdash Mega-Collectin. It contains twenty caves, with a bonus cave every 5 levels. It begins with a choice of display where one is closer to the original BoulderDash and the other is closer to Emerald Mine. It is related to Royal Boulderdash in construction, difficulty and play.

278898.overview: A pub-style, 3 reel fruit machine\slot machine gambling game for when you only want to lose pretend money. Has hold and push features and all the fun you would expect!

418093.overview:
The second coup of the newcomers from Silverbyte. light up next to you, then press the switch...
... here it looks rather gloomy. Up to ten participants can play in three disciplines : First of all there is the egg game, here two barbarians are supposed to break open a giant egg at the same time and under time pressure and then slurp it up, where the best joystick shaker wins. Well then, cheers to the feast! The 3D flight sequence on a winged dinosaur, where you can throw balloons with your helmet. Lastly, as a diver, collecting pearls from the seabed and avoiding fish is almost ingenious in comparison. experience points distributed in battle (for free assignment to the various properties of the character) hardly reveal any far-reaching effects. It is particularly puzzling why you can then save those, of all things, but not best times or tables! Enjoy the fine scrolling, the beautiful animations, the brisk music and the useful controls.

418260.overview: On overhead racing game in the style of Super Sprint by Nikki Corruptions and released and sold via mail order starting in 1990.

418308.overview: The aim is to get yourself some Karma in the mini game, and then catch fish on the main screen, by using a joystick and pressing fire on them. When you collect enough fish, the game ends. There is no point or aim beyond that, apart from to get annoyed with yourself for wanting the fish too much, and the game making sure the harder your try, sometimes the Chaos of life takes over, and there is nothing you can do except to start with the building of Karma all over again.

418379.overview: A vertically scrolling SEUCK based shooter, released as Shareware by Jonathan David West in 1992 where you "fire" water at items and people on fire. Different missions have different terrain and obstacles. Save the people by touching them without hitting them with water. Very well done within the limits of the SEUCK engine.

418524.overview:
Now the fun really begins! The range of Fun School Specials has been developed to help children with specific areas of learning. Following the success of Fun School 4, parents and teachers have been asking for software which would focus on subjects like spelling, maths and creativity skills in much greater depth. The aim of the Fun School Specials is to complement children's school work. All comply fully with the National Curriculum syllabus. MERLIN'S MATHS encourages pupils to learn the basics of counting, decimals, fractions, volumes and much more while retaining the fun element common to all Fun School programs. Brilliant graphics and eye-catching sequences reward children as they progress from level to level.
There are six activities and each game has three levels. Help screens can be called up at any time. 
What this program contains
CRYSTAL CONFERENCE: The knights of the round table help with counting, subtracting and fractions. Get the sums right and watch them enjoy their banquet.
PERFECT POTIONS: Answer equations correctly and see the puny knight turn into a hero. This teaches the basics of subtraction, division and addition.
DECISIVE DATA: Many aspects of data handling in the National Curriculum are incorporated in a game that shows how to use bar charts and averages.
BROKEN BATTLEMENTS: Counting, adding and division are needed to build a
castle wall and keep out the invaders.
MAGIC MACHINE: Uses a novel way of teaching functions to National Curriculum guidelines.
WEIGHTY WEAPONS: Learn about weight and multiplication as you help Merlin sort through old weapons in the dungeons.
All games have three levels of difficulty and a unique reporting system for recording the child's progress

418525.overview:
fun School Paint & Create. Now the fun really begins!
Dear Parent.
